name: PGLite
shortDescription: Single-container Activepieces with the embedded PGLite database and in-memory queue, for personal use on one server.

alerts.message: The first account you sign up with becomes the platform administrator. Create it right after deploying.
The embedded database runs on one server only, cannot take an Enterprise license and cannot be moved to PostgreSQL later; switching means starting over. Use the Default variant for production.
